@tct.breadcrumbs.overflow.defaultMessage: Show {count, number} more {count, plural, one {breadcrumb} other {breadcrumbs}}
@tct.breadcrumbs.overflow.description: Accessible name of the ellipsis button that replaces collapsed crumbs of a breadcrumb trail (Breadcrumbs max-items); it opens a menu with the hidden crumbs. {count} is how many are hidden. Example: `Show 2 more breadcrumbs`.
